item.title: 【Cinema Center】CLIP - My Atmos Clips - Movie, TV, Trailer, Object Demo
item.description:
Greetings fellow Atmos-fanciers from one who is new to this forum (at the time of submitting this post) but an old hand in the 'surround sound' (as it was known in days long past) game.

I have recently gotten into creating my own Atmos 'demo' scenes and thought it'd be jolly-generous of me to share the object-based fun with like-minded people.

To that end, I've made available 50+ scenes which maintain the integrity of the source video and audio components i.e. no transcoding/conversion of source video or audio in order to produce the clips. While some of the scenes have been duplicated by others, my versions may-well be the only ones that have not added a video-transcode stage to reduce file size. I make no apologies for preserving the best video/audio quality available to us at this time.

I have also made available a bunch of Atmos clips, from various third-parties, that I have taken a fancy to. I doubt any of this material is 'new' to anyone but it might still serve a purpose by being available from another source.

1. ATMOS - DEMO - MOVIE & TV SCENES

VIDEO - 4K
AUDIO* - DOLBY ATMOS (TrueHD) / DOLBY ATMOS (e-ac3**) / DTS-X
SOURCE - 4K BLU-RAY or STREAMING-RIP**
FILE FORMAT - MKV
SUBTITLES (English) - PRESENT ONLY IN DIALOGUE-HEAVY SCENES.

*English-language only
**titles not issued on 4K Blu-ray to the time of writing.

WORKFLOW
All clips were extracted from the original sources as 'lossless'*** i.e. no transcoding/conversion of source video/audio streams.
All extracted clips were then remuxed**** to remove all audio streams except the principal Atmos track.

***'Lossless Cut' freeware
****'MakeMKV' freeware


All clips in the Atmos - Demo - Movie & TV Scenes folder were created by myself, Blofelds Cat.

All clips have been successfully tested in a 7.1.4 environment (HDMI-connected to Pioneer VSX-LX503 AVR).

TEST ENVIRONMENT(S)
1. Clips played off a device's internal HDD or external USB HDD (i.e. NVIDIA Shield)
2. Clips played off NAS - A. Ethernet cable (30-metres in length)
3. Clips played off NAS - B. LAN-to-LAN ethernet (as-per 'A.') to secondary router with wi-fi enabled.

*****NAS connected to modem/router; ethernet cable from modem/router to location of furthest devices (30-metres).

TEST DEVICES - all situated 30-metres from NAS.
Desktop PC (Windows 10 Pro), running VLC software player.
Laptop (Windows 10 Pro), running VLC or KMPlayer.
NVIDIA Shield TV Pro 4K (Android), running Kodi software media player.
Apple TV 4K (Apple OS) - because this device does not pass-through lossless audio formats, only the clips with lossy E-AC3 Atmos could be tested.

Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.

2. Dolby Atmos Trailers, DTS-X Trailers, Atmos Object Demo, Trinnov Atmos Demo

These folders contain various Atmos files sourced from third-party providers. Where possible, I have endeavoured to provide clips with lossless Atmos audio. I have also provided lossy versions of some of the files for those who might have an Apple TV 4K.

The rather interesting Dune Except 7ch Atmos Sound Localization file (Atmos Object Demo folder) is sourced from YouTuber, Object Demo, who has created a host of similar clips from various Movies/TV shows. Links to downloadable E-AC3-only Atmos versions are provided in the description of each YouTube clip. Please support 'Object Demo' with 'likes' or whatever YT calls it.
